objectives: Read connected text containing multiple taught vowel teams and answer from evidence.
Explain how to identify the vowel team in the whole word, then read and spell the word conventionally.
Check accuracy by rereading the whole word or sentence.
concepts: identify the vowel team in the whole word, then read and spell the word conventionally
Different vowel teams represent different vowel sounds.
Readers blend consonants and read vowel spellings as units.
Fresh examples test transfer beyond memorised responses.

definitions.definition: Two or more letters that work together to represent a vowel sound.
Using letter-sound knowledge to read a written word.
Applying a learned skill to a new example.

workedExamples.prompt: Compare “rain”, “green” and “boat”. What should a reader identify?
workedExamples.solution: Identify the taught vowel spelling in each word and use the correct pronunciation.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner swaps vowel-team spellings. What should be checked?
workedExamples.solution: Compare the complete word with its conventional spelling and review the target vowel team.

workedExamples.prompt: Why try a fresh example after guided practice?
workedExamples.solution: A new item checks whether the learner can use the skill independently.

Advancing without checking accuracy on fresh examples.
